start: Exercise page of Lateral Raise (it has an approved clip), first visit, phone online

steps.action: Open the exercise page of Lateral Raise
user_sees: A calm empty grey frame where the clip will be, while the first download runs
must_not: An endless spinner with no picture after the download ends

steps.action: Wait for the download to finish
user_sees: The looping moving clip on a white frame; a screen reader says 'Moving demo of Lateral Raise'

steps.action: Turn the internet off, leave the page and open it again
user_sees: The same clip plays at once from the phone
must_not: An empty frame because the phone is offline
The clip downloaded a second time

start: Active workout, Incline Dumbbell Press card

steps.action: Tap the exercise picture on the card
user_sees: A sheet with the exercise name, a close button and the moving clip, with the steps under it
must_not: The sheet taller than the screen so the close button cannot be reached

steps.action: Tap Close or outside the sheet
user_sees: Back on the workout, nothing changed
must_not: A set lost or changed by opening the sheet

start: Exercise picker, an exercise with no approved clip (Barbell Bench Press)

steps.action: Tap the exercise picture in the picker
user_sees: The start and end pictures fading into each other, or the line drawings with their credit
must_not: A clip of a different exercise

start: Exercise page of Lateral Raise, first visit ever, phone offline

steps.action: Open the exercise page with no internet
user_sees: No clip frame: the page's usual stand-in picture; in the how-to sheet the drawings instead
must_not: A grey frame that never fills

steps.action: Turn the internet on and open the page again within 5 minutes
user_sees: Still the stand-in (a failed download waits 5 minutes before trying again)

start: Exercise page of Lateral Raise, the member has added their own photo or video to this exercise

user_sees: The member's own photo or video, no library clip
must_not: The library clip shown over the member's own picture

steps.action: Remove the member's own picture, open the page again
Open the page after the app gets a newer version of the clip
user_sees: The new clip; the old clip file is removed from the phone
must_not: The old and new files both kept for good
The clip of another exercise with a similar name deleted
